summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. Existing human research is retained: favourable pooled findings in some disease-related fatigue populations and metabolic surrogate changes; no healthy-adult energy benefit is shown. Human research exists and is partly favourable: the fatigue meta-analysis 35776997 (12 RCTs, 1,298 patients with disease-related fatigue, e.g. cancer and MS) found a favourable pooled effect (fixed-effect SMD 0.33), and the narrative review 29624410 reports modest evidence in chronic-illness fatigue. 35509826 (23 papers) shows favourable metabolic surrogate changes. The fatigue pool mixes American and Asian ginseng, several individual Panax ginseng trials were null between groups, and no source tests healthy adults, so per Dr. Pham's 2026-10-28 rulings there is no healthy-adult energy credit. The record becomes reference-only with approved no-credit contexts, which removes Evidence points from generic Panax ginseng products.
